name: MoYu WeiLong 3x3 V11 SE (Magnetic, 20-Magnet Ball-Core, UV Coated) - PiCube Edition
description: The MoYu WeiLong 3x3 V11 SE (Magnetic, 20-Magnet Ball-Core, UV Coated) - PiCube Edition takes the SE build and maxes it out: a 20-magnet ball-core for auto-alignment and stability, a MagLev spring system for smooth turning, and a UV-coated exterior for extra grip. It's the SE lineage with the flagship-level hardware under the shell.
features: Maxed-out SE build: The 20-magnet ball-core brings the SE line's top-tier magnetic setup, pairing stronger alignment with a stable, controlled turn.
Ball-core auto-alignment: The ball-core architecture pulls layers into place on their own, reducing lockups and smoothing out fast solves.
UV-coated grip: A super glossy UV-coated exterior adds grip and a premium feel that the frosted SE base doesn't have.
Stickerless and ready to solve: Vivid stickerless shades out of the box, no peeling, no fading.
Ball-core magnet system: The 20-magnet ball-core sets the magnetic strength and alignment behavior that define this version's feel.
MagLev spring system: Magnetic levitation replaces traditional springs for a smoother, quieter, more consistent return.
